thread:
Alex: Quick sync / ran into scheduling for performance run with SparkLens. They want 140 QPS sustained and 550 QPS bursts (3x45s). Can we confirm windows and security needs?

Meera: I can run it. Plan: ramp 0->140 QPS over 4m, soak 25m at 140, bursts 3x45s @550 with 90s recovery. Model: gpt-medium-8k (quantized). Region: us-west-2. Will need private endpoint or VPC peering for customer.

Doug: Security: customer requires KMS-managed keys, SOC2 excerpt, and assurance model weights don't leave their VPC. Recommend Dedicated POC. Also need firewall allowlist IPs.

Alex: Commercial ask: what's incremental cost for bursts if they want guaranteed capacity vs on-demand bursts? Need ballpark for call.

Meera: Rough calc: baseline 3 nodes @ $4.5/hr = $13.5/hr. Bursts add ~3 nodes; total burst time 135s = 0.0375 hr. Extra cost ≈ 3 * 4.5 * 0.0375 ≈ $0.51 per test run. Will refine post-run.

security-bot: scheduled job sb-2026-04-10-03 created

Meera: Test dataset: 8k prompts, avg len 360, 95th len 980. Using continuous batching + prefix cache. Will post run commands.

security-bot: run-start sb-2026-04-10-03 ts=4970011223

security-bot: run-complete sb-2026-04-10-03 summary:
- soak (140 qps): p50=70ms p95=245ms p99=560ms errors=0.01%
- bursts (550 qps): p50=200ms p95=730ms p99=1250ms errors=0.4% (tail under pressure first ~10s)
results: s3://redwood-runs/sb-2026-04-10-03/results.csv

Meera: Notes: soak is good. Burst windows show KPIs slightly over p95 target during warmup; correlated with KV cache misses and node scale-up lag.

Doug: Ops action items: pre-warm +2 nodes 30s before bursts, shorten autoscale cooldown to 30s for POC, bump cache prefetch TTL.

Alex: Next: Meera to prepare 1-page results + refined cost delta (committed burst vs on-demand) and attach SOC2/KMS notes for customer call tomorrow 9am PT.

Meera: Will do, posting writeup and exact commands by EOD.
